TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in the country. For TUD diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Dresden Center for Nanoanalysis (DCN) offers a position asResearch Associate (m/f/x) (subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)starting March 1, 2027 or as soon as possible. The position comprises 75% of the fulltime weekly hours and is limited to a period of 36 months**.** The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position offers the chance to obtain further academic qualification (usually PhD).Altermagnets are a new class of magnetic materials, and their properties depend strongly on crystal structure. This project studies how atomic defects and strain affect the formation of magnetic domains and domain walls in altermagnetic single crystals such as MnTe and Fe2O3. The work combines advanced electron microscopy with magnetic imaging techniques. Within the SPP 2558 “Unconventional Magnetism: Beyond the S-Wave Magnetism Paradigm” and in strong collaboration with the group of Prof. Claire Donnelly (ETH Zürich), the successful candidate will help build a comprehensive picture of how structure and magnetism interact across different length. Tasks: - acquire and analyze aberration-corrected HR-(S)TEM images and determine local chemical compositions using EDS and EELS- perform large-field-of-view strain measurements with 4D-STEM and correlate strain and defect maps with XMCD imaging- develop and apply STEM-EMCD and vortex-EMCD techniques and apply them to altermagnets- collaborate with a PhD student of Prof. Claire Donnelly (Co-PI, responsible for XMCD)- publish and present results in peer-reviewed journals and at (inter)national conferencesRequirements: - a very good university degree (e. g. Master) in physics (preferred), materials science, nanotechnology, or a related field- a profound background in solid state physics in general, and of crystal structures, crystalline defects, magnetism and the mechanics of materials, including stress, strain, and deformation in particular- experience with transmission electron microscopy or another advanced characterization method- strong analytical and quantitative skills, and an interest in computational data analysis (e.g., Python)- good written and spoken EnglishDesirable:- experience with electron microscopy of magnetic materials, EMCD, or electron holography- familiarity with magnetism, particularly antiferromagnetism or altermagnetism- experience with electron-diffraction-based strain analysis- interest in simulation of electron scatteringWe offer: - access to aberration-corrected TEM and advanced electron microscopy facilities- supervision and training in state-of-the-art techniques- the opportunity for engaging and independent work within a flat hierarchy, in an open-minded team and supportive atmosphere- flexible arrangements for work hours to support a good work-life balance- 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek)- extensive opportunities for professional development and continuing education- health care and sports programs offered by TUD- a discounted job ticket (also available as a Deutschlandticket)- participation in the supplementary pension scheme for employees in the public sector via VBL (Federal and State Government Employees Retirement Fund)TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.Application:Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents by January 4, 2027 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de) by sending it as a single pdf file to recruiting-dcn@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:recruiting-dcn@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Dresden Center for Nanoanalysis, Dr. Darius Pohl,Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website:https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Analyse, Entwicklung, Festkörperphysik, Nanotechnologie, Physik, Präsentation, Materialwissenschaft

TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in the country. Founded in 1828, today it is a globally oriented, regionally anchored top university as it focuses on the grand challenges of the 21st century. It develops innovative solutions for the world's most pressing issues. In research and academic programs, the university unites the natural and engineering sciences with the humanities, social sciences and medicine. This wide range of disciplines is a special feature, facilitating interdisciplinarity and transfer of science to society. As a modern employer, it offers attractive working conditions to all employees in teaching, research, technology and administration. The goal is to promote and develop their individual abilities while empowering everyone to reach their full potential. TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.At the Faculty of Physics, Institute of Theoretical Physics, the Chair of Network Dynamics (http://networkdynamics.info (http://networkdynamics.info) , Prof. Marc Timme) affiliated with the Center for Advancing Electronics Dresden (cfaed) offers, subject to the availability of resources, a project position asResearch Associate / Postdoc (m/f/x)(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)bridging fundamental theoretical physics research on the resilience of complex networked systems dynamics to solving immediate resilience challenges in industry starting April 1, 2027. The position is limited to December 31, 2030. The period of employment is governed by § 2 (2) Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). Balancing family and career is an important issue. The position is generally suitable for candidates seeking part-time employment. Please indicate the request in your application.Tasks: - mathematical and theoretical research on collective dynamical phenomena of complex systems and networks with a focus on designing resilient systems dynamics- develop and immediately apply concepts, methods and own research results to topical industry problems ranging from networked cyber-physical and sensor-actor systems, to electric power grids and socio-economic systems- supporting the Chair in all matters, including the acquisition of third-party funding- establishing and executing collaborative research, in particular with Lakeside Labs, Klagenfurt, Austria, and industry partnersRequirements: - outstanding university and PhD degree in Theoretical Physics or a closely related field- experience in mathematical modeling, statistical physics and nonlinear dynamics- advanced programming skills- a theory background in nonlinear dynamics and networks- experience in direct academic-industry collaborations- experience with mathematical analysis of power grid dynamics is a plus- excellent commands in English and German- high self-motivation and independent, target- and solution-driven work attitude- ideally experience in (co-) supervising students and in collaborative research- willingness to bridge into new fields and learn new tools- willingness to travel to Klagenfurt (AT) and other locations of industrial and academic collaboratorsWe offer: - the opportunity for engaging and independent work within a flat hierarchy, in an open-minded team and supportive atmosphere- flexible arrangements for work hours to support a good work-life balance- 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek)- extensive opportunities for professional development and continuing education- health care and sports programs offered by TUD- a discounted job ticket (also available as a Deutschlandticket)- participation in the supplementary pension scheme for employees in the public sector via VBL (Federal and State Government Employees Retirement Fund)TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.Application:Please submit your detailed application (in English only) including a short motivation letter that states your longer-term goals, CV with publication list, names and contact details of two references, copy of degree certificates, transcripts of grades (i.e. the official list of coursework including your grades) and proof of English language skills by December 10, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de) by sending it as a single pdf file to adminND@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:adminND@tu-dresden.de@tu-dresden.de) or to: TU Dresden, Chair of Network Dynamics, Prof. Marc Timme, Helmholtzstr. 10,01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website:https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .Ergänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte PersonenAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Theoretische Physik, Forschung, Entwicklung, Physik, Programmieren

jobs.occupation: Post-Doc: Agentic AI for Self-Driving Labs in Materials Science (Ingenieur/in - Materialwissenschaften)
jobs.description: Self-driving laboratories are revolutionizing material science these days. They rely on autonomous robotic systems that can massively speed up experimental work. Agentic Artificial Intelligence (Al) is controlling them, for example, by analyzing the data they collect and planning new experiments based on these data.At the Hereon Institute of Surface Science, we study how light metals degrade and how to control that degradation for structural, biomedical and energy storage applications. Our robotic testing platform already screens hundreds of electrolyte additives and will be extended to screen coating formulations, generating data for machine learning. In this project, in strong collaboration with the Hereon Institute of Material System Modeling you will build the AI agents that will screen properties of chemical compounds, design experiments, analyze results in real time, and draw on the literature and on our growing databases to decide what to try next. You will work hand in hand with experimental researchers, focused on degradation control. Their laboratories will be the proving ground for your agents. Join us to build a self-driving laboratory of corrosion science.We are offering a 3-year position, as soon as possible, as a Postdoc in the quickly developing field of agentic AI for materials science. The position is full-time (39 h/week) and will be located in Hereon's main campus, in Geesthacht (near Hamburg).Equal opportunity is an important part of our personnel policy. We would therefore strongly encourage qualified women to apply for the position.Your tasks:- design and implement AI agents that plan, execute and evaluate experiments on our robotic testing platform- integrate the agents with our laboratory equipment and IT infrastructure, including electronic lab notebooks and databases, to enable closed-loop experimentation- develop decision-making strategies that combine large language models (LLMs) with active learning and Bayesian optimization, so that promising compounds, coating formulations and testing conditions are identified with as few experiments as possible- work side by side with experimental scientists and translate their scientific questions into autonomous workflows that accelerate their research- build tools that extract knowledge from scientific literature and from our own datasets, turning them into machine-readable, FAIR resources- publish your results in leading journals, present at international conferences, write project reports and contribute to open-source software and open datasetsYour profile:- a completed Master's and PhD degree in computational materials science, computational engineering, computer science, data science, chemistry, physics or a related field- strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), agent frameworks, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)- experience with machine learning (ideally also active learning or Bayesian optimization)- experience with robotics, instrument control, APls, databases or software engineering- genuine interest in laboratory automation and in applying AI to real scientific problems- basic knowledge of chemistry, electrochemistry and materials science- enjoying teamwork and clear communication across disciplines, particularly with experimental researchers- very good English, knowledge of the German language is preferred but not mandatory, we support language learningOur offer:- an exciting and varied job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- an International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's Day- social benefits under the collective agreement for the German public sector and remuneration up to pay grade 13 (EntgO Bund)- very good work-life balance; options for mobile and flexible working- cooperation with Hamburg University of Technology, TUHH, our partner university- access to state-of-the-art (robotic) labs, unique scientific and technical infrastructure- access to a large international research and industrial network- funding for conferences, summer schools and courses needed or research stays- a well-connected research campus, good networking opportunities, a subsidized Deutschlandticket Job ticket) subject to certain conditions, and charging facilities for electric vehicles- a family-friendly working environment with childcare options, e. g. a daycare center close to the workplace- workplace health promotion programmes, e.g. an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)- corporate BenefitsSchwerbehinderte und diesen gleichgestellte behinderte Personen werden bei gleicher Qualifikation und Eignung im Rahmen der gesetzlichen Bestimmungen bevorzugt berücksichtigt.Bitte bewerben Sie sich mit Ihrem vollständigen Bewerbungsprofil (Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, sonstige Referenzen) über unsere Karriereseite.

JOIN OUR TEAM IN BONN FOR A FULL-TIME UNLIMITED POSITION AS SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER FINANCE SYSTEMS TRANSFORMATION (F/M/X)Finance Systems Transformation is responsible for running SHAPE+, a DHL Group cross-divisional Finance transformation program. SHAPE+ aims at driving standardization and automation of core Accounting and Cost Accounting processes across Business Units and its consolidation into ONE SAP S/4 HANA Finance ERP platform. This significantly increases the efficiency and effectiveness of our Finance set-up and is the basis for the continuous transformation and digitalization of the DHL Group Finance organization.Within the SHAPE+ organization, the Program, Deployment & Change Management workstream is responsible for the central program management of the transformation program, the overall deployment management of the platform, the definition and governance of the project methodology, training, and enablement of the teams as well as the overall change management and communication. It is complemented by the teams of Process Standards & Governance, Platform & Digitalization as well as Data Migration & Test Management.Are you ready to shape the management agenda of one of DHL Group’s most important Finance transformation programs and turn strategic priorities into measurable execution?As Senior Program Manager, you will drive high-priority program initiatives across SHAPE+, prepare decision-ready C-level management presentations such as Steering Committees, and translate complex program information into clear recommendations, actions, and follow-ups. Your profile* Minimum five years of program or project management experience in large-scale transformation programs involving multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups; preferred in IT, Finance ERP* Proven ability to prepare senior management and C-level presentations, including Steering Committee materials, decision papers, executive briefings, and concise management storylines.* Strong analytical skills and the ability to synthesize complex input from multiple stakeholders into clear insights, risks, options, recommendations, and actions.* Experience in driving continuous improvement initiatives, defining pragmatic solutions, and embedding improved ways of working across teams and governance bodies.* Strong affinity for digital tools, process automation, and AI-enabled ways of working, combined with curiosity and the ability to translate technology potential into practical business impact.* Ability to identify high-value AI use cases, build and deploy AI agents or automated workflows, and integrate them into program-management processes.* Excellent stakeholder management skills, including the ability to challenge constructively, build trust, align diverse interests, and guide teams towards common objectives.* High degree of structure, ownership, reliability, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic program environment.* Confident communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to moderate senior discussions and communicate clearly with both management and operational teams.* Advanced skills in Microsoft 365 and program-management tools such as Cloud ALM, Jira, Confluence, MS Project, PowerPoint, Excel, and Power Query; hands-on experience building solutions with integrated AI tools, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, VBA, or comparable automation technologies is strongly preferred.* A recognized project-management qualification, such as PMI, PRINCE2, or SAP Activate, or comparable qualifications is a plus.* Fluent written and spoken English and German.* Based in the Bonn area or willing to relocate.   Your benefits* Amazing chance to be part of an international and cross-divisional and interdisciplinary Finance transformation project team of internal and external professionals and thought leaders* Unique opportunity to design cross-divisional Finance processes and establish a new ERP platform based on SAP S/4HANA on a green field and shape the future of Finance at DHL Group* Management driven by best practices and state-of the art solutions* Competitive compensation package, flexible working arrangements such as home office, company day care in Bonn and cooperation with “pme Familienservice”* Leasing of company bicycle or lease of (electric) company car.* Company pension plans and other forms of retirement provision* Opportunities for further education and development, such as training / mentoring programs, workshops, or support for professional growth.
